Real output of `c8@10.1.3` on Node 22 for the demo project in `src/` and `test/`.
Not generated by hand. `src/classify.js` and the test files are the sources under test.

    c8 --reporter=lcovonly --report-dir=raw    --include 'src/**' node --test test/*.test.js
    c8 --reporter=lcovonly --report-dir=proven --include 'src/**' node --test test/props.test.js

* `raw.lcov`, `proven.lcov`: c8's lcov, unchanged (paths are already repo-relative).
* `raw_lines.lcov`, `proven_lines.lcov`: the same files with every `BRDA`, `BRF` and `BRH` line removed.
  V8 block numbers are not stable across runs, so c8 branch data of two runs cannot be compared.
* `node_native_raw.lcov`: `node --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov` on all tests, `src/` record only.
* `*.meta.json`: the report sidecar (`hypatia.proven-coverage.report-meta/1`).
* `evidence.json`: written by hand (there is no JS evidence emitter yet).
